name: Shortcut Creator
description: A utility for creating and deploying desktop shortcuts through Microsoft Intune as Win32 applications. Generates .intunewin files, detection scripts, and deployment instructions automatically. Supports URL, file path, and Microsoft Store app shortcuts with custom icons.
keywords: how to deploy desktop shortcut with intune
troubleshoot shortcut not appearing on desktop
install desktop link via win32 app
deploy url link to all users
author: Shehab Noaman

securityCheck.aiSummary: Overall, the codebase appears to implement legitimate Intune/Graph-based device management utilities. No obfuscation, no external script downloads, and no credential theft or hardcoded secrets detected. Data exfiltration is limited to locally written reports. The Install.ps1 component introduces a persistent scheduled task that renames devices on shutdown, which could be abused for persistence or cause disruption if misconfigured; ensure strict access controls, auditing, and validation of the Rename-Device-on-Shutdown.ps1 script and its interaction with the environment. Additionally, consider edge-case handling for serial retrieval to avoid unintended renames. Regular review of the Schedule/Shutdown-based workflow and its permissions is recommended as part of defensible change management.
